001package com.streamConverter.factory;
002
003/**
004 * Configuration class for factory settings.
005 *
006 * <p>This class encapsulates common configuration options for factory implementations, providing a
007 * centralized way to manage factory behavior.
008 *
009 * <p>Configuration options include:
010 *
011 * <ul>
012 *   <li>Caching control for created instances
013 *   <li>Logging level control for factory operations
014 *   <li>Error handling strategies
015 *   <li>Performance optimization settings
016 * </ul>
017 *
018 * @since 1.0
019 */
020public class FactoryConfiguration {
021
022  /** Default cache size limit */
023  public static final int DEFAULT_CACHE_SIZE = 100;
024
025  /** Default logging enabled flag */
026  public static final boolean DEFAULT_LOGGING_ENABLED = true;
027
028  private final boolean cachingEnabled;
029  private final boolean detailedLoggingEnabled;
030  private final int maxCacheSize;
031  private final long cacheExpirationMinutes;
032  private final boolean failFastOnError;
033
034  /**
035   * Creates a factory configuration with specified settings.
036   *
037   * @param cachingEnabled whether to enable instance caching
038   * @param detailedLoggingEnabled whether to enable detailed logging
039   * @param maxCacheSize maximum number of cached instances
040   * @param cacheExpirationMinutes cache expiration time in minutes (0 = no expiration)
041   * @param failFastOnError whether to fail immediately on errors
042   */
043  public FactoryConfiguration(
044      boolean cachingEnabled,
045      boolean detailedLoggingEnabled,
046      int maxCacheSize,
047      long cacheExpirationMinutes,
048      boolean failFastOnError) {
049    this.cachingEnabled = cachingEnabled;
050    this.detailedLoggingEnabled = detailedLoggingEnabled;
051    this.maxCacheSize = Math.max(1, maxCacheSize);
052    this.cacheExpirationMinutes = Math.max(0, cacheExpirationMinutes);
053    this.failFastOnError = failFastOnError;
054  }
055
056  /**
057   * Creates default factory configuration.
058   *
059   * @return default configuration instance
060   */
061  public static FactoryConfiguration defaultConfig() {
062    return new FactoryConfiguration(
063        true, // caching enabled
064        false, // detailed logging disabled by default
065        DEFAULT_CACHE_SIZE,
066        0, // no cache expiration
067        true // fail fast on errors
068        );
069  }
070
071  /**
072   * Creates a production-optimized configuration.
073   *
074   * @return production configuration instance
075   */
076  public static FactoryConfiguration productionConfig() {
077    return new FactoryConfiguration(
078        true, // caching enabled for performance
079        false, // detailed logging disabled for performance
080        200, // larger cache for production
081        30, // 30-minute cache expiration
082        true // fail fast on errors
083        );
084  }
085
086  /**
087   * Creates a development-friendly configuration.
088   *
089   * @return development configuration instance
090   */
091  public static FactoryConfiguration developmentConfig() {
092    return new FactoryConfiguration(
093        false, // disable caching for development flexibility
094        true, // enable detailed logging for debugging
095        50, // smaller cache for development
096        0, // no cache expiration for consistency
097        false // don't fail fast for easier debugging
098        );
099  }
100
101  /**
102   * Creates a testing configuration.
103   *
104   * @return testing configuration instance
105   */
106  public static FactoryConfiguration testingConfig() {
107    return new FactoryConfiguration(
108        false, // disable caching for test isolation
109        true, // enable detailed logging for test debugging
110        10, // minimal cache for testing
111        0, // no cache expiration
112        true // fail fast for clear test failures
113        );
114  }
115
116  /**
117   * Creates a configuration builder for custom settings.
118   *
119   * @return configuration builder instance
120   */
121  public static Builder builder() {
122    return new Builder();
123  }
124
125  /**
126   * Checks if caching is enabled.
127   *
128   * @return true if caching is enabled
129   */
130  public boolean isCachingEnabled() {
131    return cachingEnabled;
132  }
133
134  /**
135   * Checks if detailed logging is enabled.
136   *
137   * @return true if detailed logging is enabled
138   */
139  public boolean isDetailedLoggingEnabled() {
140    return detailedLoggingEnabled;
141  }
142
143  /**
144   * Gets maximum cache size.
145   *
146   * @return maximum cache size
147   */
148  public int getMaxCacheSize() {
149    return maxCacheSize;
150  }
151
152  /**
153   * Gets cache expiration time in minutes.
154   *
155   * @return cache expiration minutes (0 = no expiration)
156   */
157  public long getCacheExpirationMinutes() {
158    return cacheExpirationMinutes;
159  }
160
161  /**
162   * Checks if fail-fast error handling is enabled.
163   *
164   * @return true if fail-fast is enabled
165   */
166  public boolean isFailFastOnError() {
167    return failFastOnError;
168  }
169
170  /** Builder class for creating custom factory configurations. */
171  public static class Builder {
172    private boolean cachingEnabled = true;
173    private boolean detailedLoggingEnabled = false;
174    private int maxCacheSize = DEFAULT_CACHE_SIZE;
175    private long cacheExpirationMinutes = 0;
176    private boolean failFastOnError = true;
177
178    /**
179     * Sets caching enabled flag.
180     *
181     * @param enabled whether to enable caching
182     * @return this builder instance
183     */
184    public Builder caching(boolean enabled) {
185      this.cachingEnabled = enabled;
186      return this;
187    }
188
189    /**
190     * Sets detailed logging enabled flag.
191     *
192     * @param enabled whether to enable detailed logging
193     * @return this builder instance
194     */
195    public Builder detailedLogging(boolean enabled) {
196      this.detailedLoggingEnabled = enabled;
197      return this;
198    }
199
200    /**
201     * Sets maximum cache size.
202     *
203     * @param size maximum cache size
204     * @return this builder instance
205     */
206    public Builder maxCacheSize(int size) {
207      this.maxCacheSize = Math.max(1, size);
208      return this;
209    }
210
211    /**
212     * Sets cache expiration time.
213     *
214     * @param minutes expiration time in minutes (0 = no expiration)
215     * @return this builder instance
216     */
217    public Builder cacheExpiration(long minutes) {
218      this.cacheExpirationMinutes = Math.max(0, minutes);
219      return this;
220    }
221
222    /**
223     * Sets fail-fast error handling.
224     *
225     * @param enabled whether to enable fail-fast
226     * @return this builder instance
227     */
228    public Builder failFast(boolean enabled) {
229      this.failFastOnError = enabled;
230      return this;
231    }
232
233    /**
234     * Builds the configuration instance.
235     *
236     * @return created configuration instance
237     */
238    public FactoryConfiguration build() {
239      return new FactoryConfiguration(
240          cachingEnabled,
241          detailedLoggingEnabled,
242          maxCacheSize,
243          cacheExpirationMinutes,
244          failFastOnError);
245    }
246  }
247
248  @Override
249  public String toString() {
250    return String.format(
251        "FactoryConfiguration{caching=%b, detailedLogging=%b, maxCacheSize=%d, "
252            + "cacheExpiration=%d min, failFast=%b}",
253        cachingEnabled,
254        detailedLoggingEnabled,
255        maxCacheSize,
256        cacheExpirationMinutes,
257        failFastOnError);
258  }
259}
